subject: Proposed overnight response carveout & fallback routing for Glacier Bank
messages:
From: Samir Patel <ops@glacierbank.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary overnight P1 response carveout

Hi Aisha,

We have a scheduled migration of several batch systems and risk a higher-than-normal volume of lower-severity alerts overnight between 00:00-06:00 PST for the next two months. Can Redwood provide a temporary SLA amendment that relaxes the P1 response window overnight (00:00-06:00) from 30 minutes to 60 minutes for that maintenance window?

Key asks:
- Temporary window: 00:00-06:00 PST, Nov 15–Jan 15 (8 weeks)
- Formalized escalation path if an incident escalates to a cross-service outage
- Confirmation that fallback routing won’t route requests to non-compliant model pools

I attached a short export of incidents from the last 90 days for context. Please let me know what you need from our side (signatures, PO, security confirmations).

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Senior Ops Manager
Glacier Bank
Attachments: incident_history.csv
From: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2027 17:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary overnight P1 response carveout

Team — forwarding Glacier Bank's ask. High level: they want to temporarily relax P1 overnight from 30m->60m for an 8-week window and need explicit escalation/fallback controls.

Proposed internal terms (draft attached):
- Temporary carveout: 60-minute P1 response between 00:00-06:00 PST, Nov 15–Jan 15
- Weekly operations sync (30m) during the carveout; Redwood to provide incident summary
- Fallback routing: route to dedicated regional pool or RDW-compat model variants only (no external experimental pools)
- Amendment via DocuSign; require sign-off from security (they CC'd Elena)

Please review the attached SLA-carveout-draft.pdf and call out anything blocking (esp. compliance or on-call coverage). I can loop in legal if we need redlines.

Aisha
Product Lead, Account Success
Redwood Inference
Attachments: SLA-carveout-draft.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 6 Nov 2027 09:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary overnight P1 response carveout

Sounds reasonable as a short-term accommodation. My comments:
- Approve 8-week carveout conditional on weekly review and metrics showing no material customer impact after 4 weeks
- Require an explicit escalation path: P1 -> 1st on-call (regional infra) -> 2nd on-call (global SRE) -> leadership bridge. We should map names now (I suggest Dylan -> Laura -> Ben for rounds during this period).
- Require DocuSign amendment and attach to the existing account record (deal_id above).

If Laura signs off, we can send the client a controlled acceptance with the conditions.

Ben
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 6 Nov 2027 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary overnight P1 response carveout

Couple of compliance points to include before we agree:
- SOC2 scope: confirm that any fallback routing remains within SOC2-scoped clusters; we cannot route to experimental/third-party pools.
- Audit logs: ensure Glacier has 30-day event retention for incidents during the carveout window; if not, we need an exception documented.
- Require a named security contact on their side (they CC'd Elena, confirm role).

I can draft a short clause to add to the amendment. Also suggest we mandate a 24/7 paging policy for P1s (even if response window is relaxed) so that there is always an on-call acknowledgement within 10 minutes and a bridge by 30 minutes if unresolved.

-steph
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <ops@glacierbank.com>, Elena Morozova <security@glacierbank.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 6 Nov 2027 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary overnight P1 response carveout

Hi Samir / Elena — thanks for the note and the incident export. After internal review we can approve a limited, temporary carveout under the following conditions: 

1) Scope & timing: 60-minute P1 response window between 00:00-06:00 PST, Nov 15–Jan 15 (8 weeks)
2) Escalation path: 1) Glacier on-call (you), 2) Redwood regional on-call (Dylan Brooks), 3) Redwood global SRE (Laura Bennett), 4) Redwood leadership bridge (Ben Carter)
3) Compliance: fallback routing will only use SOC2-scoped regional pools or verified model variants; no experimental/third-party pools will be used
4) Observability: Redwood will provide weekly status emails with incident summaries; an internal review at 4 weeks to evaluate rolling forward or reverting the carveout
5) Paging & acknowledgement: on-call acknowledgement within 10 minutes; bridge by 30 minutes for unresolved P1s
6) Execution: amendment signed via DocuSign; Redwood to provide final DocuSign link and PO placement instructions

Attached is the draft amendment (SLA-carveout-draft.pdf). If this aligns, please confirm and we will issue a DocuSign. Once signed we will schedule the weekly ops sync.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Product Lead, Account Success
Redwood Inference
Attachments: SLA-carveout-draft.pdf
From: Samir Patel <ops@glacierbank.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Morozova <security@glacierbank.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2027 09:43:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary overnight P1 response carveout

Thanks Aisha — that aligns with our needs. Elena and I will review the amendment this morning and confirm. Please go ahead and generate the DocuSign link and weekly cadence invite. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Samir
Senior Ops Manager, Glacier Bank
